approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the Stripe Revenue Reporter

change_digest_channel_or_audience.notes: Revenue figures are sensitive. Moving the digest to a new channel or widening who can read it needs the owner.

emergency_stop.notes: The owner or finance lead can stop posting immediately. Only the owner can resume.

forbidden.stripe_write: Any refund, charge, capture, payout, or modification of a Stripe object. Not approvable by anyone; build a separate, gated agent.
forbidden.pii_in_digest: Card numbers, BIN, last-4, or full email addresses in any message. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.cache_stripe_data: Persisting Stripe responses or revenue figures anywhere. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.customer_messaging: Any message to a customer. Not approvable by anyone.
